headline: Level on 14 points, and Monaco hold the fresher legs
summary: Monaco and Lille meet on Sunday level on 14 points in Ligue 1, and they arrive in very different states. Lille were beaten 4-2 at home by Galatasaray on Tuesday, and Sunday is their fourth game in nine days. Monaco lost 1-0 at Lorient but have had longer to recover. Across 10 bookmakers, with the margin removed, Monaco are 44.7% favourites and rated 0.34 goals better, even though Lille have won the last three meetings. The goals line is 2.5, and over it is 52.2%.
read: Monaco and Lille are level on 14 points and both chasing the European places, but they arrive in opposite moods: Monaco lost 1-0 at Lorient on Saturday, while Lille were beaten 4-2 at home by Galatasaray on Tuesday and have now lost all three Champions League games. The market makes Monaco 44.7% favourites against Lille's 25.2%, rating the home side about a third of a goal better, with the goal line drifting down to 2.6 — though Lille have won the last three meetings between the clubs.

facts.fact: Monaco and Lille go into the weekend level on 14 points from seven games, Lille 4th and Monaco 5th.
facts.meaning: A direct duel for the European places — the winner ends the weekend ahead of a rival it expects to be fighting all season.

facts.fact: Lille were beaten 4-2 at home by Galatasaray on Tuesday, a third Champions League defeat in three games and still zero points.
facts.meaning: Lille arrive with the worst possible result behind them, and L'Équipe's reading was that they were "very frail defensively" despite a Soriba Diaoune double.

facts.fact: Monaco on Sunday would be Lille's fourth game in 13 days: Arsenal on 13 October, Brest on 17, Galatasaray on 21, Monaco on 25.
facts.meaning: Lille have had four days since a Champions League night, and their trip to the south comes at the end of a heavy block.

facts.fact: Monaco lost 1-0 away at Lorient on 18 October, starting that day as Ligue 1 leaders.
facts.meaning: A first defeat in five for Monaco and a flat performance: they managed only 0.6 xG against a Lorient side that created 1.74.

facts.fact: The market makes Monaco clear favourites at 44.7% to win, with Lille at 25.2% and the draw at 30.0%.
facts.meaning: Monaco's chance is close to double Lille's, so a home win is the most likely single result but far from a given.

facts.fact: The market rates Monaco about a third of a goal better than Lille: the handicap fair line sits at -0.34, with the main line at -0.25.
The market's 50/50 goal total has come down from 2.75 to 2.6, and Over 2.5 has slipped from 54.9% to 52.2% since Sunday.
facts.meaning: The market still leans slightly towards goals but expects a tighter game than it did a few days ago — around two and a half goals.

facts.fact: Lille have won the last three meetings, including 1-0 at Monaco in May, and Monaco have failed to score in the last two.
facts.meaning: Recent history between these two points the other way from the prices, which is the main counter-argument to Monaco's favouritism.

sources.fact: Monaco will be without Eric Dier and Stanis Idumbo for their European tie, with three players out but no new injuries.
Monaco manager Filipe Luís said his side will "just think about this one" and that winning is the main goal.
Filipe Luís played down a "favourites" tag, saying you only win titles in May and June.
Monaco lost 1-0 away at Lorient in Ligue 1 on 18 October despite starting the day as leaders.
RMC Sport describes Monaco v Lille as a duel between two contenders for European places in Ligue 1's 8th round.
Lille were beaten 4-2 at home by Galatasaray, their third Champions League defeat in three matches with zero points.
L'Équipe reports Lille were "very frail defensively" against Galatasaray despite a Soriba Diaoune double.
Lille's club shop was vandalised and looted during protests in France, the club reported.
